DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyoderma Gangrenosum.

The biopsy results showing neutrophilic infiltration without infection, combined with normal blood cultures and elevated glucose, strongly support this diagnosis of a neutrophilic dermatosis often associated with diabetes.
